suggested_change: Clarify: (C2) Define what constitutes a 'regression' vs. normal re-assessment across iterations. (C3) Explicitly codify carry-forward rule: 'If no contradictory evidence appears in current call, prior MEDDICC score persists; document as maintained.' (C4) Define 'specificity': require named stakeholder + concrete date or trigger, not just vague action. (C5) Change status from 'Partial' to 'Unknown' unless ≥2 named competitors from competitive set appear in call evidence.
